key_insight: Oxygen changes AlTi melt surface tension in a composition-dependent way, while interfacial oxygen enrichment suppresses aluminum surface segregation.
engineering_relevance: Controlling oxygen and alloy composition may help tune interfacial behavior in molten AlTi processing.
method: Molecular dynamics simulations of AlTi melts with oxygen.
Machine-learned interatomic potential previously tested against bulk experimental data.
Element-resolved density profiles to assess surface segregation.
evidence_signal: Simulated surface-tension results are compared with microgravity levitation measurements, but the abstract reports no quantitative agreement metrics.
watch_item: Prior testing on bulk melts does not by itself establish the potential’s accuracy for oxygen-containing interfaces.
paper_title: The effect of oxygen on the surface tension of AlTi metallic alloys
